description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarFieldReadonly, a subclass of SugarFieldBase, and primarily implements a method getEditViewSmarty that delegates to getDetailViewSmarty. It appears to define behavior related to rendering read-only field views in the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: SugarFieldReadonly
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldBase to handle read-only field display logic, specifically delegating the edit view rendering to the detail view rendering.
